definitions.explanation: The eye on the left side of the face.

examples.japanese: {左|ひだり}{目|め}だけ{視力|しりょく}が{落|お}ちてきた。
examples.english: The vision in just my left eye has been getting worse.

examples.japanese: だるまは{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}をするときに{左|ひだり}{目|め}を{書|か}き{入|い}れる。
examples.english: With a daruma, you fill in the left eye when you make a wish.

notes:
Refers to the left eye from the point of view of the person whose eye it is.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左|ひだり}{目|め}をつぶる: to close/wink the left eye
- {左|ひだり}{目|め}の{視力|しりょく}: vision in the left eye

RELATED WORDS:
- {右|みぎ}{目|め}: right eye
- {両目|りょうめ}: both eyes
- {片目|かため}: one eye
